headline: The Cuervo Group is committed to the communities that support us.
description: Community service is a core value of CG that runs from the passion and commitment of the principals down through our entire organization.
leaderNote: Christina Cuervo devoted a large part of her career to community service through her role as assistant city manager of both the city of Miami and the city of Miami Beach, playing an integral role in transforming many blighted areas of South Florida into thriving communities.
